data.body:
Fixes bug Bab15b39e03: A command surface cannot declare a positional remainder (nargs='*') to bind the tokens after '--' (e.g. ). ddflow/surfaces/registry/_aliases.py:168  does  where ; when a positional Param carries nargs='*', argparse stores a LIST, and  (line 108) does  ->  hashes the list: TypeError: cannot use 'list' as a dict key (unhashable type: 'list'). Found while settling PM-remote's critic: the perf command had to keep  as a  flag because declaring it as a -remainder (nargs='*') crashes the alias dispatch. Reproduce: declare a positional Param with nargs='*' then parse any invocation and run used_aliases; AliasChoices(['a','b']) in AliasChoices -> TypeError confirmed. Found on PM-remote.

Write the regression test first and watch it FAIL on the unfixed code; then `ddflow complete fix-Bab15b39e03 --regression-test <test>` closes the bug with the task (or `ddflow bug fixed Bab15b39e03 --regression-test <test>` first).
data.title: Fix bug Bab15b39e03: positional nargs=* remainder crashes the registry alias dispatch (unhashable list)
